editorial.note: Venus, the goddess of love, had an affair with the god of war, Mars. Her husband, the lame blacksmith Vulcan, caught them and exposed the adulterous couple to a gathering of amused gods.

Bolognese School, attributed to Pellegrino Tibaldi.The Visitation, with St Jerome and other figures, c. 1550 - 1560. Purchased in 1955.

In Greek mythology, satyrs – half-men and half-goats – were said to live in the woods and mountains. In 17th-century literature, they dwelt in the pastoral paradise of Arcadia, where one could lead a carefree life.
